Background

    • Keep datas.type as like.
    • Marshal datas and send_data consistently.
    • On existing row update, refresh datas, send_data, and updated_at.
    • Update by the matched broadcast container id.
  • src/Action/V1/Cronjob/BroadcastLike.go
    • Replace unsafe nested JSON string assertions with shared normalization.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Existing like broadcast containers refresh send_data when reused.
  • Update uses the matched broadcast row ID.
  • Broadcast type remains like.
